advisor.intro: Ask anything about this character. The advisor reads the full sheet, including what your next level grants, and answers for the current rules of this game. Check its suggestions with your GM.
advisor.introAny: Ask anything: rules, builds, spells, items, tactics, backstory. The advisor reads your full sheet, including what your next level grants. Anything it recommends is listed with why; hover a name for the rules, and add it to your sheet in one click. Check its suggestions with your GM.
